svg.title: Ondo system architecture
svg.desc: Guest app and Staff Safety Console (React) talk to a FastAPI backend. The backend runs LLM intake, a deterministic safety rules engine, You.com Search for live heat, You.com Answer for cited evidence, bookings, soak sessions and alerts, all stored in MongoDB.
svg.text: Rules decide. The LLM explains. You.com grounds every claim. Built on Emergent: React + FastAPI + MongoDB.

g.text: Soak Pass: QR, guided timer, water
Time in water vs personal limit
languages, types into any text box

svg.text: Most restrictive limit wins · risk adds up · green <35 · amber 35–60 · red >60
POST /api/prescription → bath, max °C, minutes, rounds, cool-down, water

g.text: flag guest or lower a bath’s °C
Live heat index, ships, heat news
Cited evidence for every red flag

svg.text: Every You.com call is cached in MongoDB for 10 minutes with a seeded fallback and a Live / Cached badge, so the demo never breaks. Ondo gives safety guidance, not medical advice.
